original_card.question: Can one measured replay bottleneck be sped up without dropping coverage?
methods: Profile one isolated replay and optimize the measured bottleneck.
Design source-bound reuse with explicit dependency invalidation and negative controls.
original_card.acceptance_gate: Report before/after wall time on the same fixture, retained checks and invalidation behavior.

first_step.inspect: Resolve the current selected review, separate complex/ordinary BIT/admitted BIT/outer budgets, and compare the card against live handoffs before starting. Historical ceilings require exact source/model equivalence.
first_step.scope: Source-binding orientation only; not a scientific replay or all-size proof. Materialize selected inputs if this checkout is sparse.

original_card.first_experiment: Measure one unchanged fixture, preserve check coverage, and test one optimization with invalidation controls.
original_card.bottleneck_link: Faster trustworthy replays increase review throughput and let mechanism candidates be checked sooner.
allowed_variations: Profile one stage or design one source-bound cache boundary.
scope_change_triggers: Skipping coverage or comparing different fixtures to claim speedup.

scope_change_reason: Explicit donor request to profile shared helper tests/full qualification, gate finite feasibility before construction, retain every check and require at least15% wall and CPU saving. Shared fixture setup screened out; only repeated same-input qualification passes removed.
bottleneck_link: Faster trustworthy replays increase review throughput and let mechanism candidates be checked sooner.
stop_rule: Source, observation, complete receipt, stderr or resource failure stops. No automatic retries. 180 seconds/command,1GiB sampled group RSS,1500 seconds shared cumulative; first pair then all six in B,C,C,B,B,C order must save15% wall and CPU.
evidence: PROOF.md, COVERAGE.md, PROFILE.md, BENCHMARK.json, VALIDATION.json and evidence/ preserve 15 bounded passing commands, full raw scientific receipts and the metadata preflight rejection. Normal/O/sealed coverage agrees; exact-head hosted CI remains separate.
author: Chris R / Clear1nsight
ai_assistance: Substantial OpenAI Codex assistance for source review, execution, tooling and report; no subagents, independent human or proof-kernel acceptance.

open_questions.question: Does another host reproduce the complete-qualification gain?
open_questions.why_it_matters: Three samples per arm on one unreserved host are not universal performance.
open_questions.first_step: Authenticate exact export; run full normal and optimized qualification, then the six fresh bounded measurements.

open_questions.question: Should the source qualifier expose explicit observation outputs?
open_questions.why_it_matters: A source-owned return interface could remove the scoped factory wrapper while retaining every oracle.
open_questions.first_step: Review this coverage map and source-bound observation lifetime; preserve failures before changing the source.
open_questions.blocked_by: Source-author coordination and a new source pin; no automatic transfer.
